summary: Kearny Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its fiscal third-quarter results for the period ended March 31, 2026, and the Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share payable on May 20, 2026 to holders of record on May 6, 2026. The filing also includes a slide presentation for investor meetings. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 8.01, with no special-situation components such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation.
